title: Turnip Rally
html:
Not to be confused with Turnip Cup, which also uses a Turnip as the emblem.

The Turnip Rally is the twelfth rally in Mario Kart World, represented by a Turnip. It was added in version 1.8.0 of the game alongside the Propeller Rally, and can be unlocked by playing one of the first eight rallies. It takes place around the southern region of the map, crossing through the snowy, mesa, and desert biomes to connect DK Pass with Shy Guy Bazaar.

The Turnip was previously used to represent the icon for the Turnip Cup in Mario Kart 8 Deluxe.

Notes

  • In regards to connected courses, the first five courses of this rally are reversed from last five courses of the Acorn Rally; however, the routes between them use different roads.
  • This is the only rally where every section is different from its VS Race route counterpart.
